correctness.rationale: For C=u^(1+a(v^-s-1))*v^(1+b(u^-s-1)) on 0<u,v<1, the logarithmic mixed derivative yields c=C/(uv)(PQ-s(a v^-s+b u^-s)). The product PQ is bounded below by [1+a(v^-s-1)][1+b(u^-s-1)] and hence c>=0 on s(a+b)<=1; strict interior positivity includes endpoints by positive log terms or independence. Near (1,1) c tends to 1-s(a+b); a negative limit invalidates the copula. Boundaries have uniform margins and continuous zero axes. Opposite conditional tails are 1-e^-b and 1-e^-a for s=1, zero for s<1; inversion gives (1-x)(1-y)>=e^-1. Diagonal depends only on r=a+b and upper-right joint exceedance is (1-sr)t²+O(t³), or (1-s/2)t³+O(t⁴) at sr=1. Finite density/limit tests independently checked and do not replace proof.

originality.rationale: Chesneau 2023 VP2 establishes the symmetric slice a=b up to 1/2 and another Khoudraji asymmetric deformation with powers tied to transformed arguments. The Stingray preprint gives a symmetric reciprocal construction and proposes a one-sided candidate. The audited theorem treats independently weighted common-power exponents with sharp simplex and exact two-tail region; those results are not established by the inspected earlier statements. Full text of the most plausible 2024 paper could not be obtained, so this is qualified best-of-knowledge originality.
